planets.name: TOI-871 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-871 with a 14.4-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-871 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-871. Its orbit and size follow Mistry et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
